entries.title: Psalms 55:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David.>> Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 55:2
segments: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

entries.title: Psalms 55:3
segments: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:4
segments: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
segments: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:6
segments: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:7
segments: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
segments: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
segments: Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

entries.title: Psalms 55:10
segments: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

entries.title: Psalms 55:11
segments: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.

entries.title: Psalms 55:12
segments: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
segments: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
segments: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
segments: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

entries.title: Psalms 55:16
segments: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:17
segments: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.

entries.title: Psalms 55:18
segments: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many [that strove] with me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:19
segments: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, Selah [The men] who have no changes, And who fear not God.

entries.title: Psalms 55:20
segments: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 55:21
segments: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.

entries.title: Psalms 55:22
segments: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
segments: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee.
